source:
As expected, you've lost the 1964 Election.

Despite your best efforts, perhaps it was always an impossible task to beat an incumbent as strong as Johnson from the position you began in. You were certainly never favored, so this comes as no surprise to anyone.

Despite your failure, however, the door has been opened for your followers, like Ronald Reagan, to enter Republican politics as mainstream candidates. On another note, the Southern Strategy appears to have worked in full, and Republican strategists are already taking notes on how to exploit the now wide-open South. Though your chapter may be closed, a new chapter of the Republican Party may just be beginning. In any case, your popularity in Arizona remains. Perhaps another term in the Senate is in your future?
zh:
正如预期的那样，您在 1964 年选举中失败了。

尽管你尽了最大努力，但从你开始的位置上击败像约翰逊这样强大的现任者也许始终是一项不可能的任务。你当然从未受到青睐，所以这对任何人来说都不足为奇。

然而，尽管你失败了，但你的追随者（例如罗纳德·里根）作为主流候选人进入共和党政治的大门已经打开。另一方面，南方战略似乎已经完全发挥作用，共和党战略家已经在记录如何利用现在完全开放的南方。尽管您的章节可能已经结束，但共和党的新章节可能才刚刚开始。无论如何，你在亚利桑那州中的受欢迎程度仍然存在。也许你的未来会再连任参议院一届？
